title: Chicken souvlaki with tzatziki and tomato salad
steps: Dice the chicken and marinate it with lemon juice, 2 tsp oil, oregano, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt for 20 minutes, then thread onto skewers.
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it out and stir with the yoghurt, remaining garlic, dill and salt into tzatziki.
Cook the skewers in a griddle pan for 10–12 minutes, turning.
Slice the tomatoes and onion, drizzle with the remaining oil and serve with the skewers, tzatziki and warm pitta.
